mainEntity.name: Is natural stone better than porcelain tile for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone can deliver a high-end look, but it usually needs more maintenance than porcelain or ceramic tile. If you want lower upkeep in a busy bathroom, porcelain is often the more practical choice, while stone is better when appearance and texture matter most.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stone looks premium, but it usually needs more sealing and care than porcelain. Porcelain is often the easier choice for busy bathrooms because it is durable and lower maintenance.
